name: codex-feishu-notifier
description: Send live-updating Feishu Card 2.0 lifecycle notifications through Codex hooks plus a persistent rollout watcher.

interface.shortDescription: Send Codex status notices to Feishu.
interface.longDescription: Uses Codex lifecycle hooks plus a persistent rollout watcher to catch task starts, completions, attention states, and interruptions even when a hook is missed; cards are updated in place with local queuing, deduplication, and retry.
defaultPrompt: Configure my Codex completion notices for Feishu.
